pages.title: Portable Furnace
pages.text: A portable magical furnace. While it sits in your main inventory it slowly smelts items for you, with no fuel required, at twice the normal smelting time.

$(bold)Switching modes$()$(br)Right-click the hakkero $(bold)inside your inventory$() to cycle modes: $(bold)OFF → Smoker → Furnace → Blast Furnace$(). The active mode decides which recipes it accepts.$(br2)Each of its 4 slots pulls from one neighboring inventory slot and pushes the result to another, so arrange raw material and empty space around it.
